name: Test & Verify
description: Select the tests, typecheck, lint, or build this project actually has, run them, and report only those results.

permissionsRequired.reason: Find tests that cover the change.
Read package scripts and the test that should run.
Run the project test script or a filtered subset.
Run tsc when a tsconfig exists.
Run the lint script when package.json defines one.
Run a build script that the project already defines.
Read compiler diagnostics when typecheck output is needed.

validation.rule: The reply names each check that ran and its tool result. It does not say verified when run_tests, run_typecheck, run_linter, or a build was not executed.
